text: There stood. <break time="0.8s" /> Facing the open window. <break time="0.8s" /> A comfortable, roomy armchair. <break time="0.8s" /> Into which she sank. <break time="0.8s" /> With a physical exhaustion. <break time="0.8s" /> That seemed to reach into her soul. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the window. <break time="0.8s" /> She could see. <break time="0.8s" /> In the open square before her house. <break time="0.8s" /> Trees whose tops. <break time="0.8s" /> Were trembling with the new spring life. <break time="0.8s" /> The delicious breath of rain. <break time="0.8s" /> Was in the air. <break time="0.8s" /> And in the street below. <break time="0.8s" /> A peddler was crying his wares. <break time="0.8s" /> To passers by. <break time="0.8s" /> Faintly she could hear. <break time="0.8s" /> Someone singing a distant song. <break time="0.8s" /> And countless sparrows were twittering. <break time="0.8s" /> In the eaves of the houses. <break time="0.8s" /> In the west facing her window. <break time="0.8s" /> The clouds had piled. <break time="0.8s" /> One above another but patches of blue sky. <break time="0.8s" /> Were showing here and there. <break time="0.8s" /> Through them. <break time="0.8s" /> She sat. <break time="0.8s" /> With her head thrown back. <break time="0.8s" /> Upon the cushion of the chair. <break time="0.8s" /> Quite motionless. <break time="0.8s" /> Except when a sob. <break time="0.8s" /> Came up into her throat. <break time="0.8s" /> She was like a child. <break time="0.8s" /> Who has cried itself to sleep. <break time="0.8s" /> And still sobs in its dreams. <break time="0.8s" /> Long after the crying has stopped. <break time="0.8s" /> She was young. <break time="0.8s" /> With a fair, calm face. <break time="0.8s" /> Whose lines showed. <break time="0.8s" /> A long habit of holding back her feelings. <break time="0.8s" /> And also a certain strength. <break time="0.8s" /> But now there was a dull stare. <break time="0.8s" /> In her eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> Which were fixed far away. <break time="0.8s" /> On one of those patches of blue sky.
